A dusk sky of violet, rose and amber reflected in still water beneath a dark tree line.

Created as a private commission. A painting in a similar spirit can be commissioned for your space.

Seen at scale

Riverside Dusk measures 30 × 40 in (76 × 102 cm). The drawing shows it above a three-seat sofa so you can picture it on your own wall.

Need it larger, smaller or in a different proportion? Sizes can be adapted.

Looking for something similar?

This work is offered as it is. A new painting in a similar spirit can be commissioned for your space.
